internal.title: Incident Resolved: Checkout Service Errors Due to Payment Service Flag
internal.body:
At 10:21 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high error rates in the checkout service. Investigation revealed that the root cause was an error injection in the payment service, specifically related to the paymentFailure flag causing 'Invalid token' errors. This led to knock-on errors in the checkout service and elevated errors in the frontend.

The paymentFailure flag was disabled at 10:41 UTC after approval, resulting in a rapid recovery of the payment and checkout services. Error rates returned to normal levels shortly after the flag was disabled.

Timeline:
- 10:21 UTC: Alert received for checkout service error rate spike.
- 10:41 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed payment service error injection (paymentFailure flag).
- 10:41 UTC: Flag disabled after approval.
- 10:41 UTC: Verified recovery with error rates normalized.

No further impact was observed after recovery.

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.body: Between 10:21 and 10:41 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to payment processing errors. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and all services have returned to normal operation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
